title: Old Ben's revelation
description: Only an emergency jump to lightspeed saves Han Solo and his passengers from Imperial starships in hot pursuit. Elsewhere, a captured Princess Leia is forced to watch the destruction of her homeworld Alderaan by the unprecedented might of the Death Star, an enormous globular space station supervised by Grand Moff Tarkin and his associate, the sinister, black-armored Darth Vader. When the Millennium Falcon returns to normal space speed and reaches its destination, Solo, Kenobi and Skywalker find nothing but rubble and debris where a proud planet once existed...
